visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short black hair, wearing a black dress and a blue lanyard, stands in an exhibition booth smiling. She makes peace signs with both hands while a man's hand wearing a gold watch enters from the left making a claw gesture. The background features a white wall with 'A MIDSUMMER'S ART DREAM' text and a TV screen. (2) The scene cuts to a high-angle shot of a large convention hall where a massive red spherical balloon with a white 'g' logo hangs from the ceiling. Below, elaborate table settings and stage equipment are visible under bright indoor lighting. (3) Close-ups show a circular orange sign for 'GAMA PAY' and various anime-style character standees, including a capybara with an orange on its head. The woman and man pose for photos with a staff member in a yellow uniform against a bright, colorful backdrop. (4) The woman is seen holding a character-themed folder and playing a tabletop game with colorful popping pieces. The man mimics the pose from a capybara-themed parody of 'The Scream' mural. (5) Digital screens show shopping interfaces with '購物橘子' text. People interact with large touchscreens playing a lottery game that displays treasure chests and 'Congratulations' messages. The man and woman are seen wearing mushroom-shaped paper hats in front of a wall of anime character tiles. (6) The man interacts with a glowing purple plasma globe on a rock-like pedestal labeled '天堂M'. The video concludes with a final shot of the large red 'g' balloon in the convention center rafters.
